title: 移相全橋轉換器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討移相功率傳遞、續流、占空比損失與 ZVS，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore phase-shift power transfer, freewheeling, duty loss and ZVS, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。理想 PWM 模型不包含全部漏感、磁通偏移與整流暫態；工程判讀需時域與元件條件交叉驗證。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Ideal PWM models omit leakage, flux bias and rectifier transients; interpretation needs time-domain and component-condition cross-checks.

stages.descriptionEn: Complete legs and phase shift through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.instruction: 畫出兩腿電壓及其差值，區分零電壓續流區與能量傳遞區。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「循環電流使輕載效率可能下降，單一峰值效率不可代替曲線。」的觀察。建立輸入電壓×負載矩陣，逐格標示 ZVS 狀態與損耗。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Circulating current can hurt light-load efficiency; one peak does not replace a curve. Build an input-voltage/load matrix with ZVS state and loss at each point. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 建立輸入電壓×負載矩陣，逐格標示 ZVS 狀態與損耗。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Build an input-voltage/load matrix with ZVS state and loss at each point. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「交付全範圍效率」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把移相功率傳遞、續流、占空比損失與 ZVS的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If deliver full-range efficiency disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of phase-shift power transfer, freewheeling, duty loss and ZVS behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「交付全範圍效率」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for deliver full-range efficiency, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：理想輸出近似 Vout≈Vin·(Ns/Np)·Deff。Vin=400 V、Ns/Np=0.1、Deff=0.30 時得 12 V；若換流造成有效占空比降至 0.27，則變 10.8 V，需控制補償但仍受最大相移限制。 理想 PWM 模型不包含全部漏感、磁通偏移與整流暫態；工程判讀需時域與元件條件交叉驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: ideally Vout≈Vin·(Ns/Np)·Deff. With 400 V, Ns/Np=0.1 and Deff=0.30 the output is 12 V. Commutation reducing effective duty to 0.27 gives 10.8 V; control can compensate only within the maximum phase-shift limit. Ideal PWM models omit leakage, flux bias and rectifier transients; interpretation needs time-domain and component-condition cross-checks.
